_note: Wires for the abortion feed. harvest_abortion.py reads this and writes wire_abortion.json. Each wire carries a 'standing': official, research, press, rights (abortion-rights advocacy) or antiabortion (anti-abortion advocacy). Both advocacy sides are carried deliberately and labelled on every row, so the reader always knows what they are reading. Standing is provenance, not endorsement. Edit this file to add, drop or rebalance a source. Locale coverage is expanded: several country editions per language, and each query split into slices so no single search hits Google News's ~100-result cap.
